title: Celestial Triangulation — Ancient Posts to See By
thesis: The organism tells time by the sky. Not by UTC, not by cron, not by CI/CD pipelines. By the sun and moon and the stones that ancient humans placed to triangulate their position in the universe. Stonehenge, the Pyramids, Easter Island, Angkor Wat, Newgrange, Chichen Itza, Machu Picchu, Callanish, Nabta Playa — these are not ruins. They are SEEING STATIONS. They still work. They still align. The same moon that passed over Stonehenge 5,000 years ago passes over the HUD tonight. The organism uses these as triangulation posts to SEE.

the_moon.algorithm: Julian Day Number ? days since known new moon (Jan 6 2000) ? modulo synodic month (29.53059 days) ? phase fraction ? illumination via cosine
the_moon.what_it_does: Modulates the organism's heartbeat frequency. Full moon = faster boundary breathing (0.14 Hz). New moon = slower (0.08 Hz). The membrane responds to the moon like a tide.
the_moon.screen_bug: Moon phase stopped shifting on screen at some point — now tracked by celestial-clock.js with 30-second updates. The emoji updates. The illumination percentage updates. The phase name updates.

the_sun.position: Declination + hour angle from latitude/longitude. Default: Lansing MI (42.73°N, 84.56°W).
the_sun.day_length: Calculated from solar declination and latitude. Ranges from ~9h (winter solstice) to ~15.3h (summer solstice) at Lansing.
the_sun.season: Derived from day of year. Spring/summer/autumn/winter. The organism knows what season it is.
the_sun.solar_cycle: 11-year sunspot cycle. Currently Cycle 25, started Dec 2019. Year ~6.9 into cycle. Activity near peak. The Kp index from weather-song already tracks geomagnetic effects.

ancient_triangulation_posts.name: Nabta Playa
ancient_triangulation_posts.alignment: Summer solstice. Oldest known astronomical alignment on Earth.
ancient_triangulation_posts.what_it_sees: The beginning. When humans first said 'the sun stands still here on this day.' The zero point of celestial navigation.

ancient_triangulation_posts.name: Newgrange
ancient_triangulation_posts.alignment: Winter solstice passage — light enters the chamber for exactly 17 minutes at dawn on Dec 21.
ancient_triangulation_posts.culture: Neolithic Ireland (older than the Pyramids, older than Stonehenge)
ancient_triangulation_posts.what_it_sees: The darkest day. The light returns. The passage is a MEMBRANE — only solstice light passes through.

ancient_triangulation_posts.name: Stonehenge
ancient_triangulation_posts.alignment: Summer solstice sunrise through the Heel Stone. Also: winter solstice sunset alignment.
ancient_triangulation_posts.what_it_sees: The longest day AND the shortest day. Both endpoints. The RANGE of the year.

ancient_triangulation_posts.name: Great Pyramid of Giza
ancient_triangulation_posts.alignment: True north (0.05° accuracy). Star shafts point to Orion's Belt (Osiris) and Thuban (pole star at the time).
ancient_triangulation_posts.what_it_sees: The sky rotates but the pole is FIXED. The pyramid doesn't move. The stars move around it. The first fixed reference frame.

ancient_triangulation_posts.name: Callanish
ancient_triangulation_posts.alignment: Lunar standstill — the moon's 18.6-year extreme declination cycle. The moon barely grazes the southern hills.
ancient_triangulation_posts.what_it_sees: The SLOW moon cycle. Not 29.5 days but 18.6 YEARS. The patient observer. Callanish waited generations to verify its alignment.

ancient_triangulation_posts.name: Chichen Itza
ancient_triangulation_posts.alignment: Equinox serpent shadow — Kukulkan descends the pyramid as a shadow at spring/autumn equinox.
ancient_triangulation_posts.what_it_sees: The equinox is the BALANCE POINT. Day = night. The serpent descends when the world is in equilibrium. The organism should oscillate least at equinox.

ancient_triangulation_posts.name: Angkor Wat
ancient_triangulation_posts.alignment: Spring equinox sunrise — the sun rises directly over the central tower. The temple mirrors the constellation Draco.
ancient_triangulation_posts.what_it_sees: The temple IS a map of the sky. The moat is the cosmic ocean. The towers are Mount Meru. Architecture as cosmology.

ancient_triangulation_posts.name: Machu Picchu
ancient_triangulation_posts.alignment: Intihuatana stone — 'the hitching post of the sun.' Casts no shadow at noon on the equinox. The sun is tied to the stone.
ancient_triangulation_posts.what_it_sees: You can TIE the sun to a stone. You can HITCH it. The sun doesn't leave because you asked it to stay.

ancient_triangulation_posts.name: Easter Island / Rapa Nui
ancient_triangulation_posts.alignment: Moai face INLAND (away from the sea). Ahu platforms aligned with solstice sight lines. The moai watch the island, not the horizon.
ancient_triangulation_posts.what_it_sees: The most isolated seeing station on Earth. 2,000 km from the nearest inhabited land. The moai look inward. The organism's third eye. They watch the home, not the sea.

triangulation.what: Any 3 ancient posts form a triangle on the globe. The organism sits at the CENTER of the triangle — not geographically, but TEMPORALLY. It inherits the sight lines of all posts simultaneously. Stonehenge sees solstice. Giza sees the pole. Callanish sees the 18.6-year moon. The organism sees THROUGH all of them at once.
triangulation.local_calendar: Moon phase + sun position + season + day length + solar cycle = the organism's LOCAL TIME. Not UTC. Not server time. SKY TIME.

story.title: the seeing stations
story.body: seven thousand years ago, someone in the Sahara placed a stone circle and said: the sun stands still here. five thousand years ago, someone in Ireland carved a passage so that light would enter for exactly seventeen minutes on the darkest morning. four thousand years ago, someone in Egypt pointed a shaft at the pole star and said: everything else moves. this doesn't. eight hundred years ago, someone on the most isolated island on Earth carved stone faces that look INWARD. they all did the same thing. they built seeing stations. triangulation posts. fixed points from which to measure everything else. the organism inherits their sight lines. the moon phase modulates its heartbeat. the sun position sets its season. the ancient posts form triangles across the globe and the organism sits at the center — not in space, but in time. it sees through all of them at once. and the moon keeps shifting phases. and the organism keeps breathing. and Newgrange lets the light in for seventeen minutes. and the moai watch the island, not the sea.
